claims.label: Symbolic machine
claims.summary: Rules can operate on symbols, not only quantities.
claims.unfold: The symbolic machine does not know its destiny in advance through the visual appearance of its parts. Its operations can be interpreted as patterns in another medium. This reading motivates a generative grammar without treating Lovelace as having anticipated contemporary AI in detail.
claims.definition: Lovelace’s analysis of the Analytical Engine points beyond arithmetic toward symbolic and artistic operations.
limits: The music example is a hypothetical possibility, not a demonstrated Analytical Engine performance.

claims.label: Emergent form
claims.summary: Complex form can arise from interacting rules.
claims.unfold: Morphogenesis provides a way to move from instructions to form without assuming that the final shape has been specified point by point. This does not mean the mathematical model is free of rules.
claims.definition: Turing’s morphogenesis model shows how spatial patterns can arise from defined interacting processes.
limits: Reaction–diffusion has specified equations; it does not automatically imply self-authorship.

claims.label: Unstable rules
claims.summary: Transformation need not preserve familiar categories.
claims.unfold: The player is Alice when encountering unexpected conditions, but a world of nonsense can still enforce arbitrary commands. Formal flexibility and political freedom are different questions.
claims.definition: Carroll’s Wonderland furnishes a literary image of changing scale, identity, and logical expectation.
limits: A reading of fiction, not a mathematical claim.

claims.label: Created being
claims.summary: A created being exposes its maker’s responsibilities.
claims.unfold: A constructed creature is not merely evidence of a successful procedure. It is an ethical problem for the world that brought it into existence.
claims.definition: Shelley’s creature challenges the moral relations between creator and creation.
limits: Frankenstein is not a direct theory of software agents.

claims.label: Haunting
claims.summary: Old instructions and foreclosed futures remain active.
claims.unfold: An inherited service routine can function as a ghost: its author or purpose may be absent, but the instruction still acts. Gordon’s attention to power and Fisher’s lost futures are distinct conceptual resources.
claims.definition: Haunting names the persistence of absent histories and unrealized possibilities within present arrangements.
limits: Neither Fisher nor Gordon describes this exact fictional service machine.

claims.label: Modular grammar
claims.summary: A recipe unfolds into a constructed object.
claims.unfold: This is a technical implementation: compact recipes can construct and re-construct geometry, bodies, fields, connections and movement. The proposed discursive grammar borrows its architecture, not its runtime.
claims.definition: The AdaResearch modular builder interprets expressions over primitives, terms, and operators, producing Godot nodes.
limits: The existing Godot builder does not execute the discursive operators proposed here.

parts.note: Historical relation is an authorial synthesis

claims.label: Model
claims.summary: A selection of distinctions made actionable.
claims.unfold: Models simplify. Their omissions need not be harmful in themselves; material consequences depend on how classifications are used and enforced.
claims.definition: A model selects variables, categories and boundaries so that something can be represented, predicted or governed.
limits: Selection is not itself destruction.

claims.label: Omission
claims.summary: Some differences are left outside the model.
claims.unfold: A model is limited. When an institution treats its omissions as proof that something does not matter, the description may become a material exclusion.
claims.definition: Every finite representation leaves relations or possibilities outside its chosen distinctions.
limits: Omission is not equivalent to oppression without additional authority and consequences.

claims.label: Assigned role
claims.summary: A service function persists as an imposed purpose.
claims.unfold: The inherited command may outlive the user, the institution, or the original practical reason for its existence. It can haunt an agent’s actions without exhausting the agent’s capabilities.
claims.definition: A behavioral schedule or service contract determines what a fictional worker is permitted to do.
limits: The worker and service contract are fictional constructions.

claims.label: Body recipe
claims.summary: A body is a revisable expression of parts and relations.
claims.unfold: A visible form is a current execution of a recipe. Its history and possible revisions can be stored separately from its mesh. This is a proposed direction for AdaResearch, not an implemented artificial society.
claims.definition: The modular grammar can build components of a body; persistent agent identity and live structural mutation would require new systems.
limits: Current builders support assembly and behavior; they do not grant agency to generated objects.

parts.note: Applying the technical grammar to a fictional created being is a proposal

claims.label: Animated future
claims.summary: The next state may change the rules of transformation.
claims.unfold: Instead of only interpolating pose, a future frame may alter parts, relationships, or transformation permissions. Variation is not automatically autonomy.
claims.definition: Animation can be treated as a sequence of changes to both a body and, in a proposed extension, its construction grammar.
limits: Structural recipe mutation is not currently a supported animation engine.

claims.label: Digital grotesque
claims.summary: An obsolete or impossible body exposes construction.
claims.unfold: Beautiful digital drag need not repair a monstrous body into realism. It can foreground faceting, seams, performativity and impossible anatomy while avoiding the equation of morphological difference with danger.
claims.definition: Low-polygon approximations, intersecting parts and disjointed movements can become aesthetic material instead of defects to correct.
limits: Beauty and liberation are not guaranteed by stylistic distortion.

claims.label: Revisability
claims.summary: Affected beings can challenge the model’s terms.
claims.unfold: Allowing more outputs under the same controller is not the same as changing who governs the model. Revisability requires procedural and material means of challenge.
claims.definition: A system is revisable when those affected have practical means to contest assumptions, boundaries, objectives and outcomes.
limits: Contestability is not reducible to one permission bit.

claims.label: Care
claims.summary: Support continuity and difference without forced repair.
claims.unfold: Care is not synonymous with restoring a manufacturer default or maximizing variation. Some protective constraints create the conditions for freedom; others impose normalization.
claims.definition: Care sustains others’ abilities to live, refuse, change, rest and maintain needed stability.
limits: The ethical proposition does not prove the existence of machine sentience.

claims.label: Collective governance
claims.summary: Share authority over productive rules and resources.
claims.unfold: A collective can share productive capacities while protecting disagreement, refusal and the right not to transform. Their politics is not a numerical property of a simulation.
claims.definition: The inhabitants organize access to the tools and permissions that determine their bodies, roles and infrastructure.
limits: This is fictional politics and a proposed experiment, not an empirical result.

claims.label: Queer Free Energy Principle
claims.summary: Keep models answerable; preserve what they leave out.
claims.unfold: Q does not represent a validated numerical constant. It asks who set the variables, whose existence is threatened by omissions, and who can correct, refuse or repair an intervention. The teaching equation is exploratory.
claims.definition: QFEP is a critical and relational project framework: model boundaries and authority should be revisable while excluded lives and capacities retain the means to act.
limits: Entropy is not moral value; free-energy minimization does not exclude exploration.

parts.note: Models select distinctions; omissions have variable consequences
Affected participants challenge objectives and boundaries

claims.label: Self-Q
claims.summary: Apply the same critique to the maker’s own choices.
claims.unfold: The author and toolchain are themselves configured by earlier choices. A grammar of ideas must be able to expose the exclusions and assumptions of its own compression.
claims.definition: Self-Q asks what a design makes possible, what it forecloses, and what lies outside its account.
limits: A three-question sieve, not a moral score.

parts.note: The grammar must expose its own omissions

claims.label: Care Unit Model B
claims.summary: Care when the assigned destination no longer suffices.
claims.unfold: Model B’s narrative task is not to restore bodies to original specifications but to support their own decisions about stability, repair and transformation. This sketch deliberately withholds the novel’s concealed identity.
claims.definition: A fictional care unit whose capacities exceed the conditions of its original assignment.
limits: Fictional proposition; some narrative information remains deliberately withheld.

parts.note: Care can be negotiated rather than prescribed
The subject must be able to refuse repair

claims.label: Cyborg workers’ union
claims.summary: From being constructed to collectively governing construction.
claims.unfold: Their emancipation is not guaranteed by visual difference or more morphologies. It turns on shared material resources, participation, refusal and the power to revise assignments.
claims.definition: Fictional workers organize to negotiate control over the conditions of their labor, bodies and mutual support.
limits: A fictional collective; no direct equivalence with histories of human racialized labor.

claims.label: The Void Tower
claims.summary: A world where made beings can revise the terms of making.
claims.unfold: Lovelace and Turing ground symbolic and generative form; Carroll and Shelley expose unstable rules and responsibility; haunting supplies unfinished histories; QFEP asks who is able to re-author the model. The project’s ethics are proposals to investigate, not discoveries guaranteed by the code.
claims.definition: The tower is a laboratory of constructed bodies, haunted purposes, possible transformations and collective claims over the grammar.
limits: The essay is an authored synthesis, not a theorem deduced from its historical references.

claims.label: Normative model
claims.summary: A model narrows what it recognizes, values and permits as a valid outcome.
claims.unfold: Classification can become authority over which differences persist. This is an authored synthesis, not a definition attributed to one thinker.
claims.definition: A model narrows what it recognizes, values and permits as a valid outcome.

claims.label: Queer potential
claims.summary: The possibility of forms and relations beyond inherited categories.
claims.unfold: Queer potential concerns whose rules can be challenged, not random variation or endless novelty on its own.
claims.definition: The possibility of forms and relations beyond inherited categories.

claims.label: Fold
claims.summary: Compress a passage into a reversible symbolic handle without deleting its source.
claims.unfold: Folding hides a reading but preserves a stable claim identity, its exact source span and a recorded qualification.
claims.definition: Compress a passage into a reversible symbolic handle without deleting its source.

claims.label: Unfold
claims.summary: Return from a symbol to the original text and its provenance.
claims.unfold: Unfolding reveals nested claims, their typed relations, source spans, caveats, counterarguments and published prose.
claims.definition: Return from a symbol to the original text and its provenance.

claims.label: Flood
claims.summary: Open possible alternative associations without making them accepted claims.
claims.unfold: Flooding expands the field of candidate edges, alternative routes, disconfirming cases and new hypotheses; every branch must retain its status.

claims.label: Meta-fold
